notes: Milestone Authority is the only contract that accepts project trust-root registrations; the acceptance authority is constructor-bound and each project reference is write-once.
Milestone Registry owns lifecycle, review-request state, authenticated Adjudicator callbacks, and finality-only Vault messages; it consumes Authority snapshots by view.
Milestone Adjudicator owns only hash-pinned web/LLM evidence review and returns an idempotent finalized receipt to the Registry.
The Vault has one immutable Registry controller. The milestone_core() getter remains only as a compatibility ABI alias for existing tooling.

This is the final corrected split deployment; all four contracts and both one-shot bindings are finalized and verified from chain state. The Registry was redeployed so its constructor-bound digest exactly equals the generated deployment artifact.
The frontend intentionally fails closed while any split address, source digest, or Vault runtime digest is unset or mismatched.
Run scripts/milestone_verify.sh before any Bradbury deployment transaction.
Run docs/MILESTONE_DEPLOYMENT_RUNBOOK.md in order; generate all three deployment artifacts first and pass each exact deployment-artifact digest to its constructor.

Earlier broken candidates are deliberately excluded: Registry 0x03383b... and Adjudicator 0x3CC92d... were paired correctly but the first Registry artifact exposed a private bind method; Registry 0xd9FAC... was a constructor-encoding failure; Registry 0x8A938... used the canonical source hash instead of the exact deployment-artifact digest and was superseded. None is a publication address.

GenLayer CLI 0.39.2 may fall back to 200000 gas for finalization; if that transaction reverts, the same official ConsensusMain finalizer is retried with a measured 2000000 gas limit and recorded separately.
